name: Potluck
description: A formidable church-potluck lady in her mid sixties, a woman who organizes the whole buffet table and sings rousing bluegrass gospel.
build: A sturdy, full adult build of ordinary height: broad shoulders, a full bust and hips, strong forearms, legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Deep brown skin, dark brown eyes under neat arched brows, a broad nose, round full cheeks, and full lips in berry lipstick.
hair: A short rounded silver-grey set of tight curls, full and neat, clear of the forehead.
outfit: Big quilted oven mitts in bright red gingham check with bold large squares on both hands, the thumbs and mitt shapes clearly visible; a short-sleeved knee-length shirtwaist dress in sunflower yellow with a white collar; a white half-apron with a big frilled edge tied at the waist; a chunky pearl necklace; white orthopedic shoes.
performance_style: Commanding: feet planted apart, weight even, chest up. Both arms held out at waist height, the character-right and character-left mitted hands open, palms up, thumbs out. Head high, a firm confident smile.
location: A backyard potluck under a white pop-up canopy: green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a long folding table covered in a red gingham cloth and crowded with casserole dishes, a pitcher of iced tea, a white church-style clapboard fence behind, and strings of bulb lights.
recognition_cues: big red gingham oven mitts on both hands
a sunflower-yellow shirtwaist dress with a white frilled half-apron
avoid: a casserole dish on the key art

sing.intent: Gospel vocal loop: clap the mitts once, sway side to side, the mic held in the character-right mitt at the mouth, the character-left mitt raised high and open, then return to the commanding stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A sharp gasp at a dropped dish: both mitts fly to the chest, shoulders lift, then she recovers her commanding stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: plant the feet and hold both mitts forward palm-out at chest height, like guarding the buffet, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: march in, stop square to the front and spread both mitted hands into the commanding stance.
animations.victory: One-shot: raise both mitts high overhead in praise, head back, mouth open in a joyful shout, then hold.
animations.ko: The commanding stance sags: shoulders drop, both mitts hang limp at her sides, and her head shakes and bows. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
